page.overview:
Who is Alissyndrex delga Cantonica Provincion?

Alissyndrex delga Cantonica Provincion, also known simply as The Countess, was a female Idalowd who was in the Canto Bight casino in 34 ABY. Around 34 ABY, she was the Countess of Canto Bight and was a partial owner of Zord's Spa and Bathhouse. She was a fan of the Fathier races. She wore the Onyx Bands of Cato Neimoidia. The Countess was also a rival of the Whippomorn gangster Sturg Ganna. That year she had given orders to kill Jerdon Bly aboard Yasto Attsmun's yacht. Lexo Sooger, a professional masseur who used to be an assassin was tasked with the dirty work. Sooger killed Bly, then, to cover his escape, spread a rumor that there was a fire on board, causing everyone on board to evacuate. As one of, if not the most powerful individuals in Canto Bight, it was best for the people who frequented the city and Casino not to antagonize her.

When the adopted daughter of Dor Namethian Lexo Sooger was kidnapped by Sturg Ganna, a politician and crime lord Canto Bight. Lexo, who was a humble masseur at the Zord's Spa and Bathouse was willing to do anything to get his daughter Lula back. The Countess had to sell the Zord's to Ganna himself, but thanks to an advice from Sooger, who advised her not to bet on Defancio Storsilt's stable, she won enough money to keep her share. The Countess knew Sooger well, but also Ganna, so she made him a proposal: he should kill a human named Jerdon Bly, who sold weapons to both the First Order and the Resistance. In reality, the Countess wanted to cut him out of the market to sell the weapons directly to both factions, and for personal reasons of antipathy. Also, Bly could become richer than her, and this also meant more influential, and she could not allow that. Sooger did not want to kill Bly, but he was forced to do so, otherwise the Countess would not have provided him with the favors necessary to get his daughter back. After having succeeded, he returned to her; the powerful Countess had arranged a meeting with Ganna and asked Sooger for a personal favor: to find something that particularly interested her in the Councilor's library. When Lexo managed to enter Ganna's suite and find his daughter, he also found a datapad containing the information on Ganna's plan to take over all of Canto Bight: He discovered that the Crime Lord was in league with Bly - the human he killed - and not only that; he planned to make Ubialla Gheal lose his club, to his advantage, to destroy the Canto Bight police force and replace it with his own droids, to bankrupt the Storsilt stables and to buy the Zord's to bankrupt the Countess. He sent the information to his detective friend, Neepers Panpick, who kept it aside, and in case of danger he would send it to everyone who mattered in Canto Bight. Sturg was forced to let them leave and grant several of their demands including not buying out the Countess's share of the bathhouse. Thanks to Lexo and his daughter, the Countess's continued reign over Canto Bight was assured, she went to the Zord's and toasted Lexo Sooger, while Sturg Ganna was present, although he was being massaged by others.
